messages:
alex: Heads-up — just finished the r2026 rollout window. Deploy-bot reports success but our mini smoke sampler is spiking 503s for a small slice in eu-west1.

deploy-bot: rollout r2026 -> 100% traffic (hosts: 12/12). quickchecks: PASS but minisampler: 5/120 failures in eu-west1.

alex: FWIW failures are from the 'inference-proxy' path, p95 latency OK though. sample curl below:

maria: Can you paste the failing log line?

alex: ```
2026-03-23T14:12:03Z ERROR proxy.lua: upstream 10.2.8.14:503 respond 503 chunked
req_id=xyz123 route=/v1/generate
```

sam: Looks like 503s are on two hosts only — might be kernel-level connection reuse. Any OOMs?

jo: No OOMs on metrics, but we saw increased accept queue on those two GPUS around 14:10.

health-bot: synthetic-mini-sampler: eu-west1 -> 5/120 failures, p95 latency stable, error-classification -> upstream_503

maria: Recommend temporarily pinning eu-west1 routing to previous variant (r2025) while we triage. Can someone do the pin? :thinking:

alex: I can pin the route for traffic-shift -> set modelvariant: r2025 for eu-west1. Doing it now.

Deploy action: alex ran: `redwoodctl route set --region eu-west1 --variant r2025`

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: eu-west1 pinned to r2025. Verified 100% of affected samples now hit r2025.

sam: Confirming post-pin small re-run of minisampler: 0/60 failures so far.

jo: We'll keep the pin for next 30m and run a broader smoke sweep. If green, we can unpin and reattempt a staggered rollout of r2026 for those hosts.

maria: Sounds good. Please add an item to the release notes: 'temporary regional pin due to proxy 503s, rolled back for eu-west1 only, root-cause investigation ongoing'.

alex: Added note to the release page and flagged infra for kernel-sock reuse review. I'll follow up with logs after 30m.

maria: Thanks — if anything spikes, @oncall please escalate.

health-bot: Reminder: scheduled recheck in 30m.

jo: quick checklist for post-pin: 1) run minisampler 2) check accept queue/conntrack 3) correlate host kernel logs 4) decide to unpin or rollforward

sam: I'll take #2 and #3, alex will run #1 and coordinate with infra.

alex: On it. Closing this thread in 30m unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
